facts.note: Nine o'clock bell at dinner, watches shown; Ruedi's exact, Félix 20 min behind, Girard 4 min behind, doctor 2 min ahead. The 'he tells each owner what is wrong' and watch-history lines are colour.
After dinner she worked beside the master in the atelier; at the ten o'clock bell the regulator agreed with it exactly.
He sent her downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten; it was running then and he was well.
In the kitchen she compared her watch with Rosa's clock, which was exactly fifteen minutes fast. The 'on purpose' explanation restates the fast claim and adds no time.
Piano heard from the kitchen, beginning at 10:48 and stopping at 11:01 by the kitchen clock.
Went straight to the kitchen and stayed with Rosa from arrival until after the eleven o'clock bell.
